description: Cosine between mean-pooled ESM-2 embeddings for target pairs inside one MMseqs2 cluster and for pairs drawn from different clusters.

metadata.note: Forward passes are deterministic; the seed selects inputs, not outputs. Values are specific to this device and dtype: the same specification on another backend yields the same representation, not the same bytes.

name: cluster_similarity

selection.rule: same-cluster pairs ordered by md5 of the id pair and seed; different-cluster pairs drawn uniformly at random from clustered targets present in the cache, rejecting same-cluster draws
